columns.name: INTERSECTION
columns.description: Intersection of the location of the red light enforcement camera(s). There may be more than one camera at each intersection.

columns.name: CAMERA ID
columns.description: A unique ID for each physical camera at an intersection, which may contain more than one camera.

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: The address of the physical camera (CAMERA ID). The address may be the same for all cameras or different, based on the physical installation of each camera.

columns.name: VIOLATION DATE
columns.description: The date of when the violations occurred. NOTE: The citation may be issued on a different date.

columns.name: VIOLATIONS
columns.description: Number of violations for each camera on a particular day.

columns.name: X COORDINATE
columns.description: The X Coordinate, measured in feet, of the location of the camera. Geocoded using Illinois State Plane East (ESRI:102671).

columns.name: Y COORDINATE
columns.description: The Y Coordinate, measured in feet, of the location of the camera. Geocoded using Illinois State Plane East (ESRI:102671).

columns.name: LATITUDE
columns.description: The latitude of the physical location of the camera(s) based on the ADDRESS column. Geocoded using the WGS84.

columns.name: LONGITUDE
columns.description: The longitude of the physical location of the camera(s) based on the ADDRESS column. Geocoded using the WGS84.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: The coordinates of the camera(s) based on the LATITUDE and LONGITUDE columns. Geocoded using the WGS84.
